scope: Estimates count a fixed analyst question, recorded server instructions once, every catalog snapshot or each unique tool input definition, all call arguments and all tool text replies. The SDK-wire proxy additionally counts output schemas and structuredContent duplication. No inference/model requests were made. Model rendering, catalog replay/caching, protocol framing and reasoning tokens are unmeasured.
conditions: Three alternating repetitions of the fixed six-case suite, sequential fresh MCP servers and Client/AJV instances; the Node harness and SDK code are reused across its six cases. Filesystem caches were not flushed; cold-disk behavior is unmeasured. All advertised output schemas remain full; stock SDK caching and normal JIT retained.

Two alternating cold-client batched retained controls, each in its own Node harness. Parser fixtures and oracles were acquired before profiling; oracle consumption and assertions are inside the measured harness.
All runs use two CPU affinity, a 4 GiB sampled process-family RSS guard at 200 ms, and 1 GiB Node heaps. Cleanup is awaited. All compared attempts completed without a guard stop.

Initial failed harness attempt used an incorrect GraphQL line-start oracle; descriptions start before field declaration lines. That failed attempt is retained but excluded. The corrected oracle requires declaration lines within source ranges, matching source digests.
The full default catalog is exactly equal across before/after at 241 tools and 4,257,925 bytes. Only opt-in hot-cold initial visibility changes.
independent_trace_network_oracle: Every returned source line, method, URL and status agrees with raw original ZIP trace.network JSON, checked after profiling.
case_timing_scope: Per-case milliseconds run through verified answer, excluding its final close. Suite resource receipts include every client/server close, all six completed tasks and receipt writes.
artifact_availability: Raw harnesses, catalogs, calls, original local trace/HAR captures, profiler logs and receipts remain outside Git. This summary records their digests; exact timing reproduction requires the matching external fixtures. Public stdio regression is self-contained.
